title: 장학금규정 / queue:ARTICLE:3:0:00003:part:1/1

Article 3 (Authorities Responsible for Scholarship Administration)
(1) Matters concerning the payment of scholarships, selection of recipients and other scholarship administration shall be handled as follows: <Amended on May 8, 1979; February 1, 1991; January 29, 2001; February 29, 2008; and March 23, 2013.>
1. Matters concerning students of national schools, universities and graduate schools, students studying abroad, and researchers shall be handled by the Minister of Education;
2. Matters concerning students of public or private middle schools and high schools shall be handled by the relevant Board of Education of Seoul Special Metropolitan City, Busan City or a Do.
(2) The National Treasury may subsidize scholarship expenses of Seoul Special Metropolitan City, Busan City and Do.
(3) The Minister of Education and the Boards of Education of Seoul Special Metropolitan City, Busan City and Do may delegate part of the duties concerning selection of scholarship recipients and payment of scholarships at a school to the head of the school. <Newly Inserted on May 8, 1979; amended on February 1, 1991; January 29, 2001; February 29, 2008; and March 23, 2013.>
